title: Workers Compensation Act
verified_how: Browsed the W directory: 'Workers Compensation Act [RSBC 2019] c. 1', split into Parts (19001_00 is the table of contents, 19001_01 is Part 1, and so on). Fetching 19001_00 shows 'Workers Compensation Act [RSBC 2019] CHAPTER 1' and 'current to September 15, 2026'.
notes: Provincial workplace-injury social insurance (WorkSafeBC compensation benefits and employer assessments). It replaced RSBC 1996, c. 492. Because the Act is split into Parts, encoding needs the per-Part documents.
